hfor-05-c1.text: Joshua J. Mark (2014). Bayan I. World History Encyclopedia.
hfor-05-c1.quote: He allied himself with Alboin and the Lombards and, in 567 CE, the two armies joined to crush the Gepids between them.
hfor-05-c1.claim: In 567 they joined the Lombards to destroy the Gepid kingdom,

hfor-05-c1.text: Joshua J. Mark (2014). Avars. World History Encyclopedia.
hfor-05-c1.quote: The departure of the Lombards for Italy in 568 CE removed another hostile people from Pannonia, enabling Bayan I to expand his territories with relative ease
hfor-05-c1.claim: and when the Lombards left for Italy in 568 the Avars under their khagan Bayan took over the Carpathian Basin, roughly modern Hungary.

hfor-06-c3.text: Mark Cartwright (2018). Urartu Civilization. World History Encyclopedia.
hfor-06-c3.quote: The fortress capital, Tushpa, was built on a limestone promontory on the eastern shores of Lake Van in the highlands.
hfor-06-c3.claim: and the Urartian fortresses around Van.
